Package com.agrialert.viewmodel

Class AlertsViewModel

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.viewmodel.AlertsViewModel
public class AlertsViewModel extends Object
ViewModel for managing and interacting with alerts data. Acts as a bridge between the DataManager and the UI components for alert-related operations.
